title: [2.8.2.2-dev] NSClient Full Sync => "Infinite duration" (> 1 month) / and new BG values from G6 not updated in NS during sync
symptom: Full Sync in NSClient takes extremely long (estimated 1.5-2 months) and slows down over time; during sync, new BG values from Dexcom patched app are not updated in NS. Restarting AAPS temporarily improves speed.
cause: The thread does not identify a definitive root cause; maintainer MilosKozak suspects memory management in Android or Java and notes a code snippet intended to prevent double-sending but doesn't know why it fails.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit (516630215c3adfb32577a27bea2d9a09be58b03b) and making a sync variable @Volatile; no specific user action given.
